Jason, thanks for the quick turnaround and sending the PDF. I pulled the attachment into our tax review and had a couple of clarifying asks:

- The copy you attached lists Midland as purchaser and appears signed, but it doesn't show a purchaser state resale ID. Some states accept a signed affidavit without an ID; others require the purchaser's tax registration number. Which state(s) are you claiming exemption for? (You mentioned CA/WA/OR in onboarding notes.)
- The form looks like a generic multi-state template — can you confirm the box for "Purchaser is engaged in resale" is checked and that the seller field includes Redwood Inference or our billing entity (Redwood Cloud Services, Inc.)?

If you can provide either: (a) the purchaser's state tax ID for the states claimed, or (b) a version of the form with the seller explicitly named and the appropriate boxes checked, that will speed validation.

Olga, Hannah — I'm leaving invoice INV-2026-1573 on hold until we receive the clarifying doc. Jason, if you can re-upload corrected file or a short confirmation email with the state list and resale ID(s), we can unblock quickly.

Thanks,
